versions.changelog:
Version 0.1.1

- No changes detected in files for this version.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous release.

Initial release of the Perry TypeScript-to-native compiler skill.

- Covers Perry compiler commands, perry.toml config, native UI widgets, threading, cross-compilation, plugins, auto-update, and CLI reference.
- Includes quick start commands and cross-compilation instructions for multiple platforms.
- Provides references for CLI, standard library, multi-threading, UI, internationalization, system APIs, and plugins.
- Lists common patterns for native apps, HTTP servers, and parallel processing.
